summary: Quantum Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing entry into Securities Purchase Agreements for a private placement of 10,615,712 shares of common stock at $9.42 per share, raising $100M gross proceeds ($94.7M net). The offering was placed by Cantor Fitzgerald and Lake Street Capital Markets. Net proceeds will repay all existing term debt, with remainder for working capital. The placement includes a 90-day lock-up on share issuance and lock-up agreements from officers, directors, and Dialectic, the sole beneficial owner of the company's 10% PIK notes. Closing expected June 4, 2026. Watch for registration statement effectiveness and stock overhang absorption.
